name: pm
description: DataCraft project-management layer around Matt Pocock's skills. /pm:pm-scaffold stands up a minimal starter (day-one files only — every other folder is created on first write per the stamped CLAUDE.md taxonomy); discovery riffs work into docs/intent/<slug>.md with an Acceptance block (observable checks, re-run locally then against production) and a size call; fast-grill is the pace rule for every grilling round (0.14) — technical questions go with their recommended answers to the Astra seat via Ringer and come back as ledgered rulings, the human answers only taste, one-way doors, user challenges, and seat splits; whats-next and stepping-away open and close each working SESSION (not the day) as per-session, per-person append-only logs — YYYY-MM-DD-<name>[-N].md, several a day is normal; checkpoint re-aims only a session too long to close and reopen; verify-before-done gates completion claims on fresh evidence; the credential-guard hook deterministically blocks staging credential-shaped files (compound chains, directory operands, quoted -C paths — tests in hooks/). Utility skills: okf (knowledge-bundle format) and granola-transcript (verbatim meeting transcripts into gitignored _pm/transcripts/). SDLC.md is the doctrine layer (stages, gates, artifact chain, no tools named) and WORKFLOW.md is Joe's binding of it (Ringer panel, Codex seat, Matt's skills, build-swarm at Build when the ticket frontier holds two or more independent tickets) — the stage chain of record; MIGRATION-0.8.md covers upgrades. History lives in the repo README and git log.
